visualCharacteristics.purpose: Icon-led feature list: bare centred icons with optional heading, text and link, plus split media|text panels

contentPattern.structure: icon or image cell | body cell with optional heading, text and links/buttons. Icon-only rows (no body) are allowed. In the split options (featured-offer, light-2, light-3, dark) the first cell is a photo and the second the text panel

usage: Default: bare centred icons (no card surface) with optional heading, text and link, text colour following the section Style. light: icon-only row with larger icons. icon-left: icon in its own column beside heading/text/link. dividers: items share one light surface separated by vertical rules. featured-offer: a single wide card, photo left and text right on a light surface. light-2 / light-3: photo left, text on a dark panel right. dark: whole split card on a dark surface. Section background comes from section metadata Style (forest, green, bright-green, eggshell, neon, white, black), not a block class.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for benefit/feature icon rows and single promotional media|text panels. Use cards-feature when each card needs its own boxed surface.
